name: Limbach Holdings (LMB)
teaser: Watchlist for new money. Limbach bought two companies and still guides 2026 adjusted EBITDA below its March plan. At $54.50 the price already assumes margins stay low; buy zone $40.22.
llms: Limbach Holdings (LMB) designs, installs and services mechanical, electrical, plumbing and control systems for hospitals, factories, universities and data centers. Valued with a five-year free cash flow model after stock-based pay and a forward EV/EBITDA cross-check after the CYMCOR and 1901 acquisitions. 2026 adjusted EBITDA guidance fell from a range of $90 to $94 million to $78 to $84 million even with two acquisitions; the price implies a long-term adjusted EBITDA margin of about 10.7%. Bear $35.45, Base $57.46, Bull $79.67. Verdict Hold at $54.50 (November 5, 2026 close), maximum buy price $40.22.
